title: PCA v. Korean Capital Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC found Korean Capital Presbytery's submitted, presbytery-approved responses acceptable (in order); the source does not state a dismissal, acquittal, or other formal merits disposition.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed the BCO 40 citation against Korean Capital Presbytery after the Presbytery submitted responses, approved by Presbytery under BCO 10-4, addressing the cited failure to respond to exceptions of substance in October 6, 2008 minutes.
summary: The 40th General Assembly cited Korean Capital Presbytery for failing to respond to substantive exceptions in its October 6, 2008 minutes. The SJC noted that the Presbytery had submitted responses approved by the Presbytery under BCO 10-4 and found those responses acceptable. The record does not state a dismissal, acquittal, or other formal merits disposition; the matter is an administrative BCO 40-5 citation resolved by acceptance of the Presbytery's responses.
